text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while cleaning the trainer's 
office, a notebook fell off the desk...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the time when we designed 
Epiphaneia's racing outfit.
choice_data_list_en: Oh, this notebook is...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm leaving the design of my 
racing outfit to you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Indeed! You will design it from scratch!
choice_data_list_en: Got it... Wait, me?
Got it... Wait, me?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Knowing you, who understands me so well, 
you can do it! Even the voice of destiny 
says so!"
choice_data_list: えぇ！？やったことないよ！
choice_data_list_en: Whaaat?! I've never done that before!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In other words, no one is more suited for 
this than you! I'm counting on you, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by the momentum, I ended up 
having to think of a design for the racing 
silks. That said, I have nowhere to start.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"So, we decided to visit places connected 
to her to look for design inspiration."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that brings back memories! Mom and I 
used to play tag right here, didn't we?
choice_data_list: It's quite a steep slope, though.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
A place like this is the only thing that 
could satisfy me! I just had way too much 
energy to burn!
choice_data_list_en: It's a pretty steep slope, though.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Shall we give it a shot for old time's 
sake! Let's go, Trainer!!
choice_data_list: No, no, it wouldn't even be a contest!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This is my absolute favorite among all our 
villas. The mountain out back makes the 
perfect playground!
choice_data_list: いやいや、勝負にならないって！
choice_data_list_en: No, no, it wouldn't even be a contest!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The beachside villa where you can 
swim anytime and the hilltop one with the 
panoramic night view are great, but... 
This one is the most fun!
choice_data_list: なるほど……ん、別荘の中でも？
choice_data_list_en: I see... Wait, even inside the villa?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I spent a considerable amount of time 
delving into Epiphaneia's personal side. 
Eventually, the design was finished, but—
choice_data_list: （エピの家、やっぱりすごいな……）
（エピの家、やっぱりすごいね……）
choice_data_list_en: (Epi's family really is something else...)
(Epi's family really is incredible, isn't it...)

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's really well made, so full of energy! 
It feels totally like me!
choice_data_list_en: *Gulp*... How is it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, please restart it from scratch!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it! I'm counting on you to 
make a racing outfit only you, as my 
Trainer, can create!"
choice_data_list_en: Whaaaat~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: There's still higher ground to reach!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"It's gotten way better! We're just 
getting started!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Revising it over and over again. Until I 
couldn't think of anything more to add—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Is the new one ready, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, my bad! I was just eager to see it! 
So, how is it!?
choice_data_list_en: Waaah~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was no point in trying to cover it 
up. I confessed honestly that my mind had 
gone completely blank...
choice_data_list: ごめん……もう無理かもしれない
choice_data_list_en: Sorry... I don't think I can do this anymore.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Then let's eat something sweet 
to refresh our mood!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"As a special treat, I'll cook for you 
today! Excuse the intrusion!!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sugar, eggs... and butter too! Let's 
make pancakes!
choice_data_list_en: Wait... whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing it was Epiphaneia doing the 
cooking, I had a feeling this wouldn't be 
ordinary culinary work. I'd better watch 
her closely...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaah! Mix, mix! Become delicious--!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, the amount went down! Wah! The 
floor is all soggy...!
choice_data_list:
Let's mix it focusing more on power than 
speed!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Hraaaagh!!
choice_data_list: スピードよりもパワー重視で混ぜよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's focus on power over speed when mixing!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to bake it! Heat on MAX—
choice_data_list:
Leave the heat to me! Just focus on 
flipping them!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'm counting on you! Haha, burn, 
burn, burn~~!
choice_data_list: 火力は任せて！ひっくり返すのに集中して！
choice_data_list_en: Leave the heat to me! Just focus on flipping it!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Done! My special homemade pancakes! Go 
ahead, dig in!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, we did it—!!
choice_data_list_en: ...Oh, it's actually really good!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“This proves it, though. Leaving our 
racewear to our Trainer really is the 
right call!”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"These pancakes turned out great. Though 
on my own, they would've been a disaster."
choice_data_list_en: Wait... what do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I tend to overdo things, after all! You're 
the one who kept me under control.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"What I want from my racewear is the exact 
same thing. I want it to complement and 
make up for what I lack!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Fill in the missing pieces, Trainer! Make 
this a flawless first-place finish, 
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then I can run full speed ahead! With you 
and the voice of destiny pushing me 
forward, all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia's greatest asset is her 
powerful energy. To that, I'll add my 
perspective as a Trainer.
choice_data_list_en: Epi...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer!
choice_data_list: 作ろう……俺とエピファネイアの勝負服！
作ろう……私とエピファネイアの勝負服！
choice_data_list_en: Let's make it... racewear for me and Epiphaneia!
Let's make it... racewear for me and Epiphaneia!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I just suddenly felt like wearing it, 
okay! Is it really something to be that 
surprised about?
choice_data_list_en: Epi!? Why are you in your racing outfit...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a coincidence... no, maybe it was 
inevitable! Because I heard the voice of 
destiny.
choice_data_list: ちょうど勝負服のことを思い出してたから！
choice_data_list_en: Because I was just thinking about your racing outfit!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's such a great design! I gotta show it 
to Trainer, too!
choice_data_list: I feel like I heard it too.
I think I heard it too.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's such a great design! I gotta show it 
to Trainer, too!
choice_data_list: 俺も聞こえた気がする
私も聞こえた気がする
choice_data_list_en: I think I heard it too.
I think I heard it too.
Yeah, you look cool.
Yeah, you look really cool.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see! Well then, could it sound like this 
too?
choice_data_list: 俺も聞こえた気がする
私も聞こえた気がする
choice_data_list_en: I think I heard it too.
I think I heard it too.
Yeah, you look cool.
Yeah, you look really cool.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The future I'll run towards in this 
racing attire is shining so brightly it's 
almost blinding!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Fufu, isn't it?! It's perfect for me!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You know me best, and you're the one who 
designed it!
